story_overview: Lian is held captive in a courtyard by the guard Chen. Chen also interacts with a man named Wei. Later, in her chambers, Lian is adorned with her white spike earrings and has a tense conversation with Wei, leaving them both looking concerned.

video_prompts:
Lian: Woman with long, dark hair styled in an elaborate updo, wearing a traditional light blue/green robe and a pair of long, dangling white spike earrings.
Chen: Man wearing a Guard Uniform consisting of red and black robes and a traditional black hat.
The Torchlit Courtyard: Outdoor traditional Chinese courtyard with grey stone paving, surrounded by single-story buildings with dark wooden support pillars, carved lattice screen windows, and curved gray tile roofs, featuring wall-mounted metal torches.
the heavy patterned robe: Dark, heavy-fabric robe featuring a subtle, repeating dark-on-dark pattern.
the red paper lanterns: Traditional Chinese lanterns with a spherical red paper body, black calligraphy characters on the sides, and a decorative gold tassel at the bottom.

Lian sinks to her knees on the stone paving and bows her head. Chen steps forward to stand guard over her. The heavy patterned robe lies on the ground beside Lian.
